contextReview.basis: Direct review: overcast daytime residential East Asian city lane with tiled shopfronts, a convenience store, potted plants, utility poles and overhead wires; dry asphalt, no rain depicted; humidity not inferred.

approval.evidence: Five editorials passed producer QA and continued under the user's standing workflow authorization (2026-11-03, "앞으로도 승인 없이 진행"); the user did not visually approve them individually. Product images passed producer technical QA and producer visual QA on four backgrounds only.

reconstructionNotice: Rear view: the blue jeans keep their visible rear construction (back pockets, yoke); the black blouson front and the cream sweatshirt front are conservative reconstructions. The keys in the door are a scene prop. The watch face is only partly visible. Brand, fibre composition and retail identity are unknown.

producerVisualReview.findings: All 27 isolated products have complete silhouettes, matching garment colors and visible details, clean alpha edges across four backgrounds, matching footwear/sock pairs, gold hoop pair and complete watch. No props or forced running trim. Look05 jeans retain visible rear construction; hidden garment fronts are conservative reconstructions. No visible matte, checkerboard or external shadow.

title.de: Ein Blick zurück an der Tür

deck.ko: 검정 블루종과 파란 진, 짧은 흰 발목.
deck.en: Black blouson, blue denim and a short white ankle line.
deck.de: Schwarzer Blouson, blaue Jeans und eine kurze weiße Knöchellinie.

intro.ko: 문을 열다 뒤돌아보는 각도에서 착장의 뒷선이 보입니다.
intro.en: A backward glance while opening a door reveals the outfit from behind.
intro.de: Beim Türöffnen macht der Blick zurück die Rückseite des Outfits sichtbar.

body.ko: 검정 블루종의 짧은 밑단 아래 중간 파랑 진의 패치 주머니가 드러납니다. 크림 크루넥이 목선에서 검정을 부드럽게 나누고, 흰 리브 양말과 검정 로퍼가 발목에 명확한 대비를 만듭니다. 작은 시계까지 같은 어두운 톤으로 묶었습니다. 뒤에서 오는 플래시가 재킷의 주름과 진의 봉제선을 잡습니다.
body.en: Below the short black blouson, mid-blue jeans show their rear patch pockets. A cream crewneck softens the dark neckline, and white ribbed socks contrast clearly with black loafers. A small dark watch continues the restrained palette. Flash catches jacket folds and denim seams from the rear angle.
body.de: Unter dem kurzen schwarzen Blouson zeigen mittelblaue Jeans ihre aufgesetzten Gesäßtaschen. Creme am Rundhals lockert den dunklen Kragen auf. Weiße Rippstrümpfe setzen sich klar von schwarzen Loafern ab, eine kleine dunkle Uhr bleibt im ruhigen Farbschema. Blitz betont Jackenfalten und Jeansnähte aus rückwärtigem Winkel.

pull.en: Three clear tones, even from behind.
pull.de: Drei klare Helligkeiten auch von hinten.

copy.pullQuoteEn: Three clear tones, even from behind.

tip.ko: 소매 끝을 살짝 밀어 시계를 드러내고 양말의 흰 높이를 일정하게 맞추세요.
tip.en: Push the cuff back a little to show the watch and keep both white sock lines even.
tip.de: Das Bündchen etwas zurückschieben und beide weißen Sockenlinien gleich hoch halten.

description.ko: 작은 칼라와 앞지퍼, 주름 잡힌 커프와 밑단의 검정 재킷.
description.en: Black zip jacket with a small collar and gathered cuffs and hem.
description.de: Schwarze Zipjacke mit kleinem Kragen und gerafften Bündchen und Saum.

howToWear.ko: 지퍼를 조금 열어 크림 목선과 검정 칼라를 구분하세요.
howToWear.en: Open the zip slightly to separate cream neck and black collar.
howToWear.de: Den Zip leicht öffnen und Cremeausschnitt vom schwarzen Kragen trennen.
